_why: prune_backups.py deletes backups, the only undo for an unversioned memory store. These rows prove the tests notice if a guard that narrows deletion stops working.

mutations.name: full-snapshot-unprotected
mutations._mechanism: The newest full snapshot is deleted like any other old backup.

mutations.name: index-means-full
mutations._mechanism: Any backup holding MEMORY.md counts as full, so a partial one is protected and the real full snapshot is deleted.
mutations.find: return bool(targets) and all((d / t).is_file() for t in targets)

mutations.name: symlink-followed
mutations._mechanism: A symlink to a sibling backup inside the root passes the resolve check and is scheduled for deletion.
mutations.find: if (ts is None or p.is_symlink() or not p.is_dir()
mutations.replace: if (ts is None or not p.is_dir()

mutations.name: foreign-names-deleted
mutations._mechanism: Directories without a backup timestamp are treated as old backups.

mutations.name: cutoff-inclusive
mutations._mechanism: A backup exactly N days old is deleted (off-by-one at the boundary).
